profile.name: Umar Farooq Khan
profile.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
profile.bio: Senior AI Software Engineer specialising in LLMs, agentic systems, and production GenAI, building autonomous AI pipelines, LLM orchestration frameworks, and full-stack AI products end-to-end.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI)
highlights: Engineered a Behavioural Rules Extraction Engine that mines user editing patterns to extract implicit behavioural rules and injects them into agent prompts as learned constraints; a closed-loop RLHF analogue in prompt-space; lifted approval rate from 48.5% baseline to 90.1%; reduced rejected outputs by 5×

Built Verification-Gated Self-Correcting Agents that autonomously critique and iteratively refine their own output against learned constraints until quality thresholds pass; with bounded retries for guaranteed termination. Deployed with a cost-routed model cascade that reserves top-tier models for generation and judging while funnelling lightweight tasks to smaller models

Built a production LLM Orchestration Framework with a two-tier agentic router; deterministic paths handle unambiguous tasks while an LLM tool-choice layer on Claude Sonnet resolves ambiguous ones by selecting the right tools; streaming structured output
Engineered a Dynamic Context Pruning Engine that scores and evicts low-relevance tokens in real time as agentic sessions grow, preserving critical context within fixed token budgets

Built a Workflow Automation Engine on a DAG execution runtime that resolves task graphs with partial-failure propagation; 40+ modular automation tasks across 6 types on serverless AWS with exactly-once execution guarantees, driving 8× growth in monthly automated content workflows

Established the engineering team's AI-assisted development standards; a living agent rulebook encoding architecture guardrails and coding conventions that every team member's agent loads as system context before every session; extended with custom agent tools as repeatable workflows and a persistent memory layer so agents start each session already knowing non-obvious project constraints
Managed multi-environment deployments on SST with AWS Lambda, S3, and API Gateway
